title: GnuPG Agent Configuration Schema
description: Supported kebab-case directives for Mirage-managed ~/.gnupg/gpg-agent.conf files. Boolean values emit their directive when true; false omits it and leaves GnuPG's built-in default in effect.

allow-emacs-pinentry.description: Allow Pinentry to route passphrase entry through Emacs.

allow-loopback-pinentry.description: Allow clients to use loopback Pinentry mode.

allow-mark-trusted.description: Allow clients to add keys to the user trust list.

allow-preset-passphrase.description: Allow gpg-preset-passphrase to seed the agent cache.

auto-expand-secmem.description: Allow secure memory to grow; an integer sets the suggested growth size in bytes.

batch.description: Disable Pinentry and other operations that require user interaction.

browser-socket.description: Set the browser support socket path.

check-passphrase-pattern.description: Path to a pattern file used to check newly entered passphrases.

check-sym-passphrase-pattern.description: Path to a pattern file used when creating symmetric keys.

debug.description: Set debugging flags using a GnuPG debug expression.

debug-wait.description: Wait this many seconds before entering the processing loop, for attaching a debugger.

default-cache-ttl.description: Passphrase cache lifetime in seconds, reset whenever an entry is accessed.

default-cache-ttl-ssh.description: SSH key cache lifetime in seconds, reset whenever an entry is accessed.

disable-check-own-socket.description: Disable the agent's periodic check for a replaced socket.

enable-passphrase-history.description: Enable passphrase history; this directive is currently a no-op in GnuPG.

enable-putty-support.description: Enable PuTTY Pageant protocol support on Windows.

enable-ssh-support.description: Expose the SSH agent protocol and set SSH_AUTH_SOCK when starting the agent.

enable-win32-openssh-support.description: Enable the native Windows OpenSSH agent protocol.

enforce-passphrase-constraints.description: Prevent users from bypassing configured passphrase constraints.

extra-socket.description: Set the extra agent socket path; use "none" or "/dev/null" to disable it.

faked-system-time.description: Use this Unix timestamp as the system time; intended for testing.

grab.description: Ask Pinentry to grab the keyboard and mouse.

ignore-cache-for-signing.description: Bypass cached passphrases for signing operations.

keep-display.description: Ignore requests to change the X11 DISPLAY value.

keep-tty.description: Ignore requests to change the controlling TTY.

listen-backlog.description: Maximum number of pending connections to the agent socket.

log-file.description: Append agent diagnostics to this path or socket URL.

max-cache-ttl.description: Maximum lifetime in seconds for cached passphrases.

max-cache-ttl-ssh.description: Maximum lifetime in seconds for cached SSH keys.

max-passphrase-days.description: Ask users to change passphrases after this many days.

min-passphrase-len.description: Minimum passphrase length before GnuPG displays a warning.

min-passphrase-nonalpha.description: Minimum number of non-alphanumeric passphrase characters before a warning.

no-allow-external-cache.description: Tell Pinentry not to use an external passphrase cache.

no-allow-loopback-pinentry.description: Disallow clients from using loopback Pinentry mode.

no-allow-mark-trusted.description: Prevent clients from adding keys to the user trust list.

no-detach.description: Keep the agent attached to the console, primarily for debugging.

no-grab.description: Do not ask Pinentry to grab the keyboard and mouse.

no-user-trustlist.description: Ignore the per-user trust list and use only the system trust list.

pinentry-formatted-passphrase.description: Ask Pinentry to enable formatted passphrase entry.

pinentry-invisible-char.description: Single character Pinentry may display in place of entered passphrase characters.

pinentry-timeout.description: Pinentry inactivity timeout in seconds; zero requests no timeout.

pinentry-touch-file.description: Path Pinentry should touch on exit; use "/dev/null" to disable this behavior.

s2k-calibration.description: Set the passphrase protection calibration time in milliseconds.

s2k-count.description: Override the calibrated iteration count used for passphrase protection.

scdaemon-program.description: Path to the smartcard daemon program.

ssh-fingerprint-digest.description: Digest algorithm used to display SSH key fingerprints.

sys-trustlist-name.description: System trust list filename or path.

tpm2daemon-program.description: Path to the TPM 2.0 daemon program.

write-env-file.description: Write agent environment information to this file.
